subject: general
question: ‘India’s Struggle for Independence’ is one of the notable books written by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bipan Chandra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

__
 
• **Bipan Chandra** is one of the most esteemed historians in India.
 
• "India's Struggle for Independence" is a comprehensive and detailed account of **India's 200-year-long battle** against British Rule.
 
• The book narrates the saga of the great Indian uprising, from the revolt of **1857 to the final victory in 1947**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here's the information on the other authors:

 
 

 Author
 Notable Works / Area of Specialization
 
 
 
 

 Sekhar Bandyopadhyay
 Sekhar Bandyopadhyay is a renowned historian specializing in the history of the Indian subcontinent, particularly the history of nationalism in India. His notable works include "From Plassey to Partition: A History of Modern India".
 
 

 R. K. Narayana
 R.K. Narayan was one of the most prominent Indian English novelists. His works predominantly revolve around the fictional town of Malgudi. He authored classics like "The Guide" and "Swami and Friends".
 
 

 R. C. Majumdar
 Ramesh Chandra Majumdar was a historian and professor of Indian history. Known for his detailed work on ancient and modern India, his most notable works include "History of Ancient India" and "History of the Freedom Movement in India".
